releases.notes: The first App Store submission (§537). The header is ios/1.0.0+<build>; the registry matches on the version alone, so raising CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION per upload changes nothing here - set build to the one Apple approves. Recut with --force from the submitted commit if the app's routes change before it ships; recut for build 4 (§565), for build 7 (§584's second audit), the first cut to read the app's relative api/v1/ calls, and for build 8 (§605: the tour, the free month's claim), and for build 9 (§617: the 11.14 notes, §606's password-first step, §612's episode ids on saves, vibes and shares), which replaces build 8.
The first kept release: the web client as it stood when staging was built (§172).
